sn8.4:1.1: On one occasion the Venerable Ānanda was dwelling at Sāvatthī in Jeta’s Grove, Anāthapiṇḍika’s Park.
sn8.4:1.2: Then, in the morning, the Venerable Ānanda  dressed and, taking bowl and robe, entered Sāvatthī for alms with the Venerable Vaṅgīsa as his companion.
sn8.4:1.3: Now on that occasion dissatisfaction had arisen in the Venerable Vaṅgīsa; lust had infested his mind.
sn8.4:1.4: Then the Venerable Vaṅgīsa addressed the Venerable Ānanda in verse:
sn8.4:2.2: My mind is engulfed by fire.
sn8.4:2.3: Please tell me how to extinguish it,
sn8.4:3.1: “It is through an inversion of perception
sn8.4:3.2: That your mind is engulfed by fire.
sn8.4:3.3: Turn away from the sign of beauty
sn8.4:4.3: Extinguish the great fire of lust;
sn8.4:4.4: Don’t burn up again and again.
sn8.4:5.3: Apply your mindfulness to the body,
sn8.4:6.2: And discard the tendency to conceit.
sn8.4:6.4: You will be one who fares at peace.
